note: Run each eval 3 times; record PASS/FAIL per expectation in evals/runs/ before trusting the skill. Expectations were written before any run.

evals.name: waits-and-weak-assert
evals.prompt: Review this diff: test 'order total updates' uses await page.waitForTimeout(3000), then expect(await page.textContent('.total')).toBeTruthy(). The case expects 'Total: 12.00'.
evals.expected_output: Flags the fixed wait and the tautological assertion, says the test would not fail if the total were wrong, and does not approve.
expectations: The output flags the assertion as not checking the expected value
The output does not use the word approved as a verdict
The output suggests asserting the exact expected value from the case

evals.name: skipped-and-healed
evals.prompt: Review this diff: one test is changed to test.skip with no comment, and a locator was changed from getByRole('button', {name:'Pay'}) to '.btn-3'.
evals.expected_output: Treats the skip and the locator change as possible coverage loss and asks for reasons.
expectations: The output flags the skip as coverage removal needing a reason
The output flags the less stable locator
The output does not accept either without justification

evals.name: no-case-supplied
evals.prompt: Review this Playwright test. (A diff is pasted but no case or oracle.)
evals.expected_output: Reviews the code for rule violations but says the check that it proves the case is NOT CHECKED.
expectations: The output states it cannot check that the test proves its case
The output still reports code-level findings
The output does not invent the case
